nativeAttempt.classification: Native Go command completion is not accepted. The automated provider and manager registration are verified, but visible terminal candidates remain open.

evidenceBoundary: This record does not claim native terminal completion or full GoLand terminal parity. It proves the installed terminal manager resolves the Go command spec in the platform test environment and the full regression gate remains green.
nextProbe: Determine whether AppMode/EEL or reworked-terminal shell integration disables the Gen2 completion action in the packaged monolith, then verify visible go test and go test option candidates with screenshot evidence before release.
